mentions.name: promptfoo
mentions.description: Open-source (MIT) CLI and framework for evaluating and red-teaming LLM applications. Users define test cases, run evals against any model (OpenAI, Anthropic, local models, etc.), and catch regressions before they hit production. Currently adding multi-agent evals, better tracing, voice, and static code analysis for AI security use cases.
mentions.problem: LLM testing is deceptively hard, and regressions need to be caught before they hit prod.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on promptfoo, an open-source (MIT) CLI and framework for eval-ing and red-teaming LLM apps. Think of it like pytest but for prompts - you define test cases, run evals against any model (OpenAI, Anthropic, local models, whatever), and catch regressions before they hit prod.
